environments.name: 14 Old Barracks Road — The Panopticon Death Chamber
environments.visual_anchors: Sterile windowless concrete vault with stark white walls and overhead industrial fluorescent tubes. Heavy Soviet-era reinforced iron blast door with small 6-inch tinted viewport glass, electronic keypad with glowing crimson red digital countdown clock (01:00:00), hydraulic pistons and manual locking bars. In the center is a brushed metallic interrogation desk with a glowing cyan terminal monitor and office chair. Along the wall stands a steel multi-tier industrial rack containing torture implements (sledgehammer, stun baton, acid carboys). Ceiling has brass pressurized Nox gas vents.
